text:
anya: starting flint13b int8 canary. early runs show intermittent OOMs when max_new_tokens >= 400 and microbatch=6. dropping logs here.

sam: paste the worker log and config pls.

anya: log snippet:
```
alloc failed: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation at step 90
kv_cache=14.2GB free=430MB
slot_frag rose 0.62->0.79 after prefetch
```
config: flint13b, int8, microbatch=6, max_new_tokens=512, prefetch=on, batch_window_ms=8

lee: sounds like fragmentation from prefetch + large microbatch. can you repro with a short-loop?

anya: repro: 300 reqs varying prompt len 40-380, OOMs start ~110 reqs. not deterministic.

maria: quick mitigations: try microbatch=3 + batch_window_ms=25 and set max_new_tokens=256. that reduces KV churn.

jon (via DM): ran smoke with micro=3 + batch_window_ms=25 + max_new=256 -> 1k reqs no OOM, p95 latency +10%. tokens/sec ~370 vs 420 baseline.

sam: proposal: trim prefetch for prompts <128 tokens and add per-request prefetch soft cap. also add an OOM-retry path that retries with microbatch=1 + prefetch=off once.

lee: agree on retry as cheap mitigation.

anya: prototype retry flow planned. infra-bot: please collect slab/free lists on canary hosts if OOM occurs.

infra-bot: collection scheduled for canary-flint-01..03. s3://redwood-infra/canary/flint13b/oom-6561234567.tar.gz

maria: next steps: 24h smoke with micro=3 + batch_window_ms=25, land prefetch-trim behind flag, add OOM-retry, run 1k-prompt eval vs fp16 and report regressions >3 BLEU.

anya: opening PRs and kicking off smoke. will update thread. :thumbsup:
